owner_scope: Authorized three-cycle implementation/technical exercise; main requires separate launch instruction
scientific_claim: Output-route information deployment; predictive development E0/predictive only, not E1/E2/E3

mechanism.original_forward: z = dropout_mask * relu(T @ h + Tb); logits = O @ z + Ob
mechanism.h_residual_forward: z = dropout_mask * (relu(T @ h + Tb) + alpha * h); logits = O @ z + Ob
mechanism.locality: O exact output-local CE error. H and T fixed-feedback original gradient, no backprop through learned downstream or temporal states
mechanism.data_before_feedback: Observed raw bytes and current neural/dropout state only; never target, world role or editing labels
mechanism.sensory: unchanged authentic FE-PERM 88-channel native 5177-KC single circuit

preflight.source_parity: NORMAL literal; HRES(alpha=0) literal; local H/T gradient; readout finite difference; all 257 classes
preflight.sham: No prediction target in gain, match realized post-dropout feature norm within same state; record clipping and degenerate cases
preflight.data_hashes: Must lock authentic source assets before execution
preflight.control_invalid_response: CONTROL_NOT_QUALIFIED; preserve partial data and stop before affected update; no cap8 change

primary.signed_pairwise: HRES−NORMAL<0 and HRES−NORM_SHAM<0 with record-cluster bootstrap 95% upper CI <0
primary.marginal_guards: HRES below its own A-train mean forecast and source-matched A-train unigram
primary.alignment: Frozen read-only H residual shuffled across different records matched on site position; evaluate aligned vs shuffled eligible-only sites; no training on sham
primary.caveat: No automatic E1/E3, model adoption or independent confirmation

lifetime_guards.correction: EDIT2 vs NOEDIT2 changed-target new/old log2 odds

inference_conventions.primary: pooled total byte/EOS loss, point<0 and percentile CI95 upper<0 versus both controls
inference_conventions.alignment_permutation: cyclic successor in hash-ordered eligible records; require different record at same position
inference_conventions.lifetime_margins: nonpositive point-loss differences as D1; not certified safety
inference_conventions.static_checkpoint_configuration: arm/alpha stored and mismatched restore rejected
